refnamediv.refpurpose: Calculate the power spectrum of the autoregressive model.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [psd, f_out] = ar_psd(a, v) [psd, f_out] = ar_psd(a, v, freq) [psd, f_out] = ar_psd(a, v, freq, fs) [psd, f_out] = ar_psd(..., range) [psd, f_out] = ar_psd(..., method) [psd, f_out] = ar_psd(..., plottype)

listitem.para: List of m=(order + 1) autoregressive model coefficients. The first element is the zero-lag coefficient, which always has a value of 1.
Square of the moving-average coefficient of the AR model.
Frequencies at which power spectral density is calculated, or a scalar indicating the number of uniformly distributed frequency values at which spectral density is calculated. (default = 256)
Specifies the frequency range of the spectrum. Options include 'half', 'onesided', 'whole', 'twosided', 'shift', or 'centerdc'.
Specifies the method to calculate the power spectrum. Options include 'fft' or 'poly'.
Specifies the type of plot. Options include 'plot', 'semilogx', 'semilogy', 'loglog', 'squared', or 'db'.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Function ar_psd() calculates the power spectrum of an autoregressive model using the provided coefficients `a` and variance `v`. It supports various methods for spectrum calculation and allows customization of frequency range and plot type.
